meta.title: Resolve
meta.description: To live on is more important than sacrifice.

units.rawText: At the Data Center's emergency escape tunnel.
units.displayText: At the Data Center's emergency escape tunnel.

spans.text: At the Data Center's emergency escape tunnel.

units.rawText: This place is shaking after multiple cannon shots, but it's still maintaining its original shape. Turing darts between the falling chunks of debris.
units.displayText: This place is shaking after multiple cannon shots, but it's still maintaining its original shape. Turing darts between the falling chunks of debris.

spans.text: This place is shaking after multiple cannon shots, but it's still maintaining its original shape. Turing darts between the falling chunks of debris.

units.rawText: Soon... We'll be out of here soon...
units.displayText: Soon... We'll be out of here soon...

spans.text: Soon... We'll be out of here soon...

units.rawText: A light gradually appears before her eyes.
units.displayText: A light gradually appears before her eyes.

spans.text: A light gradually appears before her eyes.

units.rawText: I'll be there right away...
units.displayText: I'll be there right away...

spans.text: I'll be there right away...

units.rawText: Beepbeepbeep!
units.displayText: Beepbeepbeep!

spans.text: Beepbeepbeep!

units.rawText: A transmission? It's Miss Sol!
units.displayText: A transmission? It's Miss Sol!

spans.text: A transmission? It's Miss Sol!

units.rawText: Thank goodness you're alright, Miss Sol!
units.displayText: Thank goodness you're alright, Miss Sol!

spans.text: Thank goodness you're alright, Miss Sol!

units.rawText: An indistinct joy swells in Turing's heart as she puts the call through while she runs.
units.displayText: An indistinct joy swells in Turing's heart as she puts the call through while she runs.

spans.text: An indistinct joy swells in Turing's heart as she puts the call through while she runs.

units.rawText: Miss Sol, I'm at the emergency tunnel's exit, I'll be—
units.displayText: Miss Sol, I'm at the emergency tunnel's exit, I'll be—

spans.text: Miss Sol, I'm at the emergency tunnel's exit, I'll be—

units.rawText: A faint echo reaches her, and both Turing's voice and footsteps stop.
units.displayText: A faint echo reaches her, and both Turing's voice and footsteps stop.

spans.text: A faint echo reaches her, and both Turing's voice and footsteps stop.

units.rawText: She hangs up the call, her finger on her terminal's "send" button. The sticky, dripping sound of the Entropics grows louder and louder, drowning out the beeps of the communicator.
units.displayText: She hangs up the call, her finger on her terminal's "send" button. The sticky, dripping sound of the Entropics grows louder and louder, drowning out the beeps of the communicator.

spans.text: She hangs up the call, her finger on her terminal's "send" button. The sticky, dripping sound of the Entropics grows louder and louder, drowning out the beeps of the communicator.

units.rawText: ...You're not Miss Sol.
units.displayText: ...You're not Miss Sol.

spans.text: ...You're not Miss Sol.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Exposed... And so soon...</color>
units.displayText: Exposed... And so soon...

spans.text: Exposed... And so soon...

units.rawText: <color=purple>As I thought... There was a hidden exit...</color>
units.displayText: As I thought... There was a hidden exit...

spans.text: As I thought... There was a hidden exit...

units.rawText: <color=purple>The hero's colleague... tried to trap me backstage... But she failed...</color>
units.displayText: The hero's colleague... tried to trap me backstage... But she failed...

spans.text: The hero's colleague... tried to trap me backstage... But she failed...

units.rawText: <color=purple>Because I... Have no body to be trapped...</color>
units.displayText: Because I... Have no body to be trapped...

spans.text: Because I... Have no body to be trapped...

units.rawText: A dark purple silhouette oozes out of the building, taking form in front of Turing.
units.displayText: A dark purple silhouette oozes out of the building, taking form in front of Turing.

spans.text: A dark purple silhouette oozes out of the building, taking form in front of Turing.

units.rawText: <color=purple>You... Don't seem afraid.</color>
units.displayText: You... Don't seem afraid.

spans.text: You... Don't seem afraid.

units.rawText: I am the former administrator of the Rossum Sector, and Hannah's research assistant.
units.displayText: I am the former administrator of the Rossum Sector, and Hannah's research assistant.

spans.text: I am the former administrator of the Rossum Sector, and Hannah's research assistant.

units.rawText: That is why I can't lose my nerves.
units.displayText: That is why I can't lose my nerves.

spans.text: That is why I can't lose my nerves.

units.rawText: <color=purple>The former administrator... Research assistant... It resembles the relationship... My sister and I used to have.</color>
units.displayText: The former administrator... Research assistant... It resembles the relationship... My sister and I used to have.

spans.text: The former administrator... Research assistant... It resembles the relationship... My sister and I used to have.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Allow me to introduce myself... I am the pious herald of the end... You may call me</color> <color=red>Odette</color>.
units.displayText: Allow me to introduce myself... I am the pious herald of the end... You may call me Odette.

spans.text: Allow me to introduce myself... I am the pious herald of the end... You may call me
Odette
